title: News motion video production file
description: The editable structured production file. Every field a human might want to tweak (headline wording, scene order, timings, transitions, voice, music, aspect ratio) lives here so a re-render never requires touching code.

headline.description: Final approved headline, shown in the chyron.

font_file.description: Absolute path to a licensed font. The user must supply this; do not embed system fonts you lack rights to redistribute.

voiceover_script.description: Word-for-word narration text, kept to ~55-80 words for a 20-30s read.

type.description: 'outro' points at a pre-rendered animated outro clip (see make_outro.py).

path.description: Local path to the vetted asset (image/video/outro clip).

accent_color.description: For endcard only, e.g. 0xE60023 (the FOLLOW pill / stripe color).

source.description: Where this asset came from (URL or provider).

attribution.description: Required credit line if the license needs one.

rights_verified.description: false triggers a warning in the manifest and blocks silent use.

story.description: The original source story, kept for records/traceability.

logo.description: Path to the account logo (user-supplied, PNG with alpha preferred).

voice.description: Path to the generated narration mp3/wav/m4a.

bgm.description: Path to the music bed. Recorded in the manifest with its license.

timing.description: Path to the TTS boundary sidecar (voice.m4a.timing.json). When present, subtitles are rendered karaoke-style (each word highlights as spoken).

subtitle_file.description: Path to the .srt burned into the video and also delivered as a separate output.
